description: This file contains functions related to monitoring file system settings and checking compatibility issues, specifically determining if VFS for Git is enabled or incompatible within a repository context.

methods.name: enum:fsmonitor_reason check_vfs4git(struct repository * r)

methods.description: Determines if there are any incompatibilities related to FSMonitor, primarily calling check_vfs4git to assess VFS for Git status.
